title: Sgr A*, the Milky Way, the Sun and dark matter
structural_note: With no disk, bulge or cluster nodes, the Milky Way SCW has to own the ordinary matter itself: stars and gas, about 53% of the pull at the Sun. That is the one structural difference from the full build.

one_line: Sgr A* and dark matter are both superposes children of the Milky Way: two terms added to its own field, neither of them the center. The Sun is the only contains child, bound by the sum of all three. Sgr A* is in charge only within 3.69 pc, and dark matter is never seen, only felt.
